Summary: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth, forming the world by His word over six days and resting on the seventh. He made human beings in His own image, male and female, and placed them in the Garden of Eden to work it and care for it.
Significance: Everything begins with a good Creator who made people on purpose and for fellowship with Him. When life feels chaotic, Creation reminds us our hope rests in the One who was there first and still sustains all He made.
